segments.text: Ever wanted to run Windows apps on Linux without breaking immersion? Windboat makes it happen seamlessly. It's like Windows for Penguins, letting you launch
any Windows app right inside your Linux desktop with native OS level Windows file sharing and full desktop access when you need it. Behind the scenes,
it's a clever mix of Docker, free RDP, and remote app magic, blending two worlds into one clean interface.
Windboat's still in beta, so expect a few waves. But if you're comfortable tinkering, it's absolutely worth the
